papers.title_en: Vibe-Coded and Tuned: A State-of-the-Art SMT Solver for QF-LRA
papers.evidence: LLM氛围编码并参数调优的SMT求解器
papers.tldr: 针对线性实数算术（QF-LRA）的 SMT 求解难题，本文提出求解器 primo。primo 完全由 vibe-coding 生成，并借助系统文献调研、反复性能剖析与参数调优完成优化。在 QF-LRA 基准上，primo 达到当前最佳性能，并超越 SMT-COMP 2026 该赛道冠军。该工作表明，vibe-coding 有望为自动推理工具带来显著进展。
papers.abstract_en: This paper presents the SMT solver primo, which is fully vibe-coded and then parameter-tuned, achieving state-of-the-art results on linear real arithmetic (QF-LRA). The performance of primo is achieved by a systematic literature survey, repeated profiling, and parameter tuning. The resulting solver outperforms the winner of the QF-LRA track of SMT-COMP~2026. This confirms that vibe-coding of automated reasoning tools will enable us to make great strides in the future.
